about.description: MU is a single-stock perpetual on Ondo Perps tracking Micron Technology Inc. Micron Technology Inc. is a US semiconductor manufacturer focused on DRAM and NAND memory (Nasdaq: MU). The market is cash-settled with hourly funding, no shareholder rights, and no dividend rights in the underlying.
